desc:
Welcome to Boombox Tower! 👋🔊

Climb your way to the top while playing ANY music you want 🎶🔥
Bring your favorite songs, sounds, memes, and absolute chaos with you as you conquer the tower 😂

Upgrade your boomboxes as you climb to unlock better, louder, and crazier speakers 🔊✨
Customize your setup and show everyone what you’re listening to!

Reach the top and discover a special surprise waiting for you 👀🎁
But be careful... you might also unlock some hilarious ways to troll the other players 💀😂

Play your music, mess with your friends, climb the tower, and become the ultimate boombox master!

Like the game 👍 and join the Group for extra perks 🎉
